title: A Prayer for Today
body: Father, thank You for this new day. Give me strength for what lies ahead, wisdom for every decision, and a heart that stays close to Yours. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Peace
body: Lord, quiet the noise in my mind. Where I carry worry, replace it with Your peace that surpasses understanding. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Gratitude
body: Father, thank You for every gift I overlook — breath, family, grace upon grace. Teach me to notice them today. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Strength
body: Lord, when I am weary, remind me that Your strength is made perfect in my weakness. Carry what I cannot. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Guidance
body: Father, direct my steps today. Where I am uncertain, give clarity. Where I am afraid, give courage rooted in trust in You. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Others
body: Lord, bring to mind someone who needs You today. Use my words, my time, or my silence to point them toward Your love. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Surrender
body: Father, I lay down what I've been holding too tightly. Have Your way in my plans, my time, and my heart. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Healing
body: Lord, You are near to the brokenhearted. Touch what is hurting in me and in those I love, and make us whole again. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Joy
body: Father, let the joy of the Lord be my strength today, not because everything is easy, but because You are good. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Faith
body: Lord, where my faith is small, grow it. Help me trust You even when I cannot see the whole picture. Amen.

title: A Prayer of Thanksgiving
body: Father, before I ask for anything else, thank You. For today, for grace, for another chance to walk with You. Amen.

title: A Prayer for Rest
body: Lord, teach me to come to You when I am weary, and to receive the rest only You can give. Amen.
